verdict.rationale: Close documents user-defined custom fields with configurable name, data type, multi-value support and edit permissions, shareable across leads and custom activities, plus custom object types (close-docs-27, close-docs-28, close-docs-24). Filtering is evidenced only as an Advanced Filtering API (close-docs-22), and nothing in the pack shows saved, sorted or shared views built by an ops user in the UI. missing for 10: evidence of saved/shared views, sorting in views, a no-admin/no-code UI path for ops users to create fields and views, independent or hands-on corroboration.
